kind: design tokens; map these into the renderer, not a raw G2 theme object

font.family: IBM Plex Sans, Microsoft YaHei, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
font.files: skills/report-layout/assets/fonts (SIL Open Font License); embedded in report HTML

states.meaning: Actuals solid; forecasts dashed lines or lighter bars; estimated history dotted. Label each state in the legend.

format.compactScale: Explicit unit label; preserve source precision in the dataset
format.source: Readable source title plus period/date; no opaque IDs

meaning: One meaning per colour: navy = actuals or the primary series; grey = forecasts and the base case; teal = the covered company and headings; red = negatives and the bear case only; green = the bull case and positive changes only. Extra series use navy and teal tints, never new hues.
